'''Jagomir''' was a [[Water/Legends|humid]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Jaga's Cluster/Legends|Jaga's Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] set up a [[Resolute Base|base]] there after [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|being forced]] to abandon their [[Arda Base|base]] on [[Arda I]]. While it had no known native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species, Jagomir was teeming with thousands of [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and animals, many of which were extremely dangerous.

The surface of the planet contained thirty continents and a number of seas. Nearly seventy-five percent of the planet's surface was swampland.

==Description==
[[File:Azurdactyls-OaAI.png|thumb|left|220px|A group of azurdactyls flying with an Alliance X-wing.]]
Jagomir was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[Jaga's Cluster/Legends|Jaga's Cluster]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]]. The planet's orbit lasted 329 [[Standard day/Legends|days]] and its rotations lasted thirty [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="OAAI" />

Two-thirds of Jagomir was covered by [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] and other wetlands. The planet had about thirty [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] landmasses on its surface, which were divided by deep [[Ocean/Legends|seas]]. Jagomir's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was [[Water/Legends|humid]] and rich in [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], though it was sometimes uncomfortable to breathe. The planet's environment was made more unpleasant by its high [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]] and because vehicles could break down easily if not properly secured against the humidity.<ref name="OAAI" />

Jagomir was a dangerous world. Some of its hazards were biological, such as the [[Poison/Legends|venomous]] [[evarrian hunter]]s and multiple [[Disease/Legends|diseases]]. Others were ecological, such as sinkholes and thick mist.<ref name="OAAI" />

==History==
Some time before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] built a [[Jagomir pirate base|base]] in Jagomir's [[Aethrorn Mountains]]. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] would construct a facility code-named [[Resolute Base]] in the same mountains. Jagomir was chosen as a potential base because it was located far from [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] activity. Regardless, it was only used as a base by a group of Rebels who were fleeing their [[Arda Base|base]] on [[Arda I]], which had recently been attacked by Imperial forces.<ref name="OAAI" />

==Inhabitants==
Jagomir had no native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], although it was home to the [[azurdactyl]], which was semi-sentient. After fleeing their base on Arda I, 306 members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic landed on the planet. That group was primarily composed of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]]. Sometime prior to the arrival of the Rebels, a group of pirates also called the planet home.<ref name="OAAI" />
